newsitem.title: GERMANY: Metalgesellschaft H1 96/97 pretax profit up 50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Metalgesellschaft H1 96/97 pretax profit up 50 pct.

text.p: Germany's Metallgesellschaft AG, the diversified engineering and trading group, said on Wednesday that its pre-tax profit for the first half of 1996/7 rose by 50 percent to 106 million marks.
The firm said that its sales for the same period rose 18 percent to 7.7 billion marks.

"The financial situation of the firm has improved further," Metallgesellschaft said in a statement. It added that for the financial year 1997/98, it expected profits to be above those in the previous year.
MG said that the year-earlier pre-tax profit of 70 million marks was hit by delays in billing plant construction contracts.
